predecessors.name: Prince-Bishopric of Würzburg
predecessors.text: the secularised Prince-Bishopric of Würzburg, held by the Electorate of Bavaria 1803-1805 (except about 826 km2 given to other princes), exchanged back for Tyrol at Pressburg

successors.name: Kingdom of Bavaria
successors.text: most of the grand duchy, which Bavaria made the Untermainkreis, now Lower Franconia (de page)

ledger.x: 26 December 1805: Würzburg is made an electorate for Ferdinand of Tuscany.
1806: the Electorate of Würzburg becomes the Grand Duchy.
1810: Schweinfurt goes to the Grand Duchy of Würzburg.
3 June 1814: the Grand Duchy of Würzburg is dissolved.

wars.name: War of the Third Coalition
wars.outcome: The Peace of Pressburg (26 December 1805) takes Salzburg from Ferdinand for Austria and gives him Würzburg, which Bavaria gave up in exchange for Tyrol.

wars.name: War of the Sixth Coalition
wars.outcome: On 26 October 1813, after Leipzig, 'Ferdinand dissolved his alliance with the First French Empire'; under the Austrian-Bavarian treaty of 3 June 1814 the grand duchy passed to Bavaria.

certainty.note: The page gives no boundary; the state was the old Prince-Bishopric of Würzburg (minus about 826 km2 lost in 1803 and plus Schweinfurt in 1810), whose edge is drawn from the Cliopatria shape of the swapped row.

sources.title: Ferdinand III, Grand Duke of Tuscany
